City of Encinitas
Planning Commission
AGENDA
AUGUST 3, 2023 -
06:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. If at least two (2) Planning Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
5.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act (open meetings for local bodies, California Government Code Section 54950 et seq.).
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Commissioner, or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
6A.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES for the May 18, 2023 Planning Commission meeting.
STAFF CONTACT: Deana Gay, Planning Commission Clerk
Staff recommends approval.
Approval of the May 18, 2023 Minutes
Approval of the August 3, 2023 Minutes
6B.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES for the June 1, 2023 Planning Commission meeting.
STAFF CONTACT: Deana Gay, Planning Commission Clerk
Staff recommends approval.
Approval of the June 1, 2023 Minutes
6C.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES for the June 15, 2023 Planning Commission meeting.
STAFF CONTACT: Deana Gay, Planning Commission Clerk
Staff recommends approval.
Approval of the June 15, 2023 Minutes
7.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
REGULAR AGENDA - ACTION ITEMS
8A.
PROJECT NAME: Heritage tree application at Moonlight Beach; CASE NUMBERS: HTREE-003531-2019; FILING DATE: October 28, 2019; APPLICANT: Tanner McConlogue; LOCATION: 400 B Street (APNs: 258-042-30-00); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider a heritage tree nomination for a Canary Island Date Palm located at Moonlight State Beach. ZONING/OVERLAY: The project site is located within the Moonlight Beach Park (D-MBP) zone and in the Coastal Zone and Coastal Appeal Jurisdiction, Specific Plan, Special Study, and; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The request is exempt from environmental review pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3) when it can be seen with certainty that there is no possibility that the activity in question may have a significant effect on the environment and the activity is not subject to CEQA.  None of the exceptions in Section 15300.2 exists.
STAFF CONTACT: Sara Cadona, Associate Planner: (760) 633-2697 or
scadona@encinitasca.gov.
Staff recommends approval.
Moonlight State Beach Case# 003531-2019-HTREE
9.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
10.
PLANNING COMMISSION REPORTS
11.
SECRETARY REPORTS
12.
ADJOURNMENT Adjourn to the regular Planning Commission meeting of August 17, 2023.
